g.text: lookups switched, with and without the address
A: grey band, a random part of the J++ part's share at the same dose; dotted, the lookup's bar (0.10).
Ring: the first dose where the J++ part by itself switches at least 0.3 of recalls; the rule asks 0.2 beyond
B: without the address against without a random part of the address's share. The rest also switches recalls at
dose 1 (0.73 / 0.13 / 0.24), fewer than a random complement of its share (0.96 / 0.68 / 0.49).
No dose's plain-text loss passes twice the whole change's; none is shaded. Whiskers: 95% (cluster bootstrap
